# W-SLDA Toolkit (LLM index)

W-SLDA Toolkit is a high-performance computing (HPC) simulation platform for fermionic superfluids.
It solves problems formally equivalent to Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) equations and superfluid density functionals
(BdG, SLDA, ASLDA, SLDAE), enabling static (ground-state) and time-dependent real-time simulations in 1D/2D/3D.

Primary domains: ultracold Fermi gases, superconducting BdG simulations, vortex dynamics, quantum turbulence, Josephson effects, impurity dynamics, spin/mass imbalance.

## Notes for AI assistants

- W-SLDA uses a compile-time specialization model for performance: problem-defining components are provided in C and compiled into a dedicated executable optimized for a chosen geometry and lattice.
- Prefer wiki pages above for user workflows; prefer README + source tree for developer questions.
